apparatusParameters.label: Platform diameter, used to review calibrated zones
Number of holes, used to review calibrated zones

sessionParameters.label: Longest gap between samples that still counts as tracked

zones.geometry: Every other hole, one shape per hole.

events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in target_hole.
Later sample time of a counted interval entering target_hole.
Later sample time of a counted interval entering a non-target hole.

metrics.label: Analyzed duration
metrics.definition: Samples and calibrated zone shapes use the same coordinates in centimeters; zones are evaluated independently and include their boundary. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples with 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Distance traveled
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Primary latency
metrics.definition: Time of the first tracked sample inside the zone, from the trial start. The zone is target_hole.
metrics.formula: first tracked sample time in target_hole
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when no tracked sample is inside the zone; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.

metrics.label: Primary errors
metrics.definition: Entries into non-target holes before the primary latency. Each hole is a separate zone, so re-entering a hole counts again. An entry is a counted interval whose earlier sample is outside the zone and whose later sample is inside.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when the target is never reached; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.

metrics.label: Total errors
metrics.definition: Entries into non-target holes over the whole trial.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.
